answer: Pair each identity, without warning, into a live two-party negotiation where both sides must forge a joint bid from private figures revealed turn by turn. One operator behind many clones becomes the bottleneck: the signal of a real agent is answering each turn in character and on time, while clones queue on the same mind and miss windows or echo each other's concessions. Miss the ledge of the deadline and the round pays nothing, so scale itself throttles the farm.
